high_priority_issues.description: matrix-from-lists crashes with 'car of empty list' error if any row after the first is shorter than the first row
complex-pow returns (complex 0 0) for 0^w when w has negative real part; mathematically should be infinity/error
sparse-coo-add-impl uses O(N^2) dense accumulator, defeating sparse storage purpose and causing memory exhaustion
sparse-csr-mul uses O(N^2) dense accumulator, defeating sparse storage purpose and causing memory exhaustion
eigen-decomposition uses unit vectors as fallback when inverse iteration fails; mathematically incorrect for general matrices
normalize-signal causes division by zero for empty vectors (no guard for n=0)
(cdr (assq 'body post)) crashes if post lacks 'body' field; pattern appears at lines 41, 71, 94, 136, 148
sanitize-tag-value claims to prevent path traversal (../) but does not filter '.' or '/' characters

notable_false_positives.description: quat-from-euler 'y' component calculation allegedly wrong - formula is actually correct per ZYX standard
d-pow negative exponent infinite recursion - code explicitly handles negative exponents at lines 202-204
tech-debt.ss references 'fabric' and 'thimble' directories - actually references 'core shell' which exist
parse-trigger.js missing comment support - comments ARE stripped before parsing at lines 15-18
llm-agent-poll.ss global depth counter - now uses per-agent state files (state-file-for agent)
llm-agent-poll.ss race condition in save-count! - now uses atomic temp-file-then-rename pattern
llm-agent-poll.ss incomplete JSON escaping - now handles all control chars U+0000-U+001F per RFC 8259

notable_gaps_found.description: vec-div does not handle division by zero - will throw unhandled exception
matrix-from-lists silently truncates rows LONGER than first row - silent data loss
complex-div throws exception instead of returning error value - inconsistent with Core 'total' philosophy
convolve-direct-full produces output-len=-1 for empty inputs, causing make-vector failure
Regex doesn't handle multiline quoted strings - common in S-expressions
deliberation-stage data structure access (cadr/cddr) mismatched with stage-&&& output structure
process-trigger uses bare (read) to parse trigger files with no validation - security concern
collection-all? has inconsistent missing-block behavior vs collection-any?
count-string-occurrences has same O(N^2) complexity issue as count-occurrences

observations.qa_quality_variance: High variance across QA agents: agent-69da had 100% accuracy while agent-5 had only 42% accuracy (8 confirmed, 10 rejected)
observations.line_number_accuracy: Many QA reports had incorrect line numbers (off by 10-200+ lines), suggesting agents worked with outdated file versions or had counting issues
observations.outdated_reports: Several 'high' severity bugs in agent-5's report were already fixed in current code (atomic writes, JSON escaping, per-agent state files)
observations.severity_adjustments: 2 issues upgraded from medium to high (eigen unit vector fallback, path traversal gap); 4 issues downgraded from high to medium

common_patterns.fabric_to_core_renames: Multiple files still have 'fabric/stitches/' or 'fabric/patterns/' in header comments after being moved to 'core/'
common_patterns.tail_recursion: Many data structure functions are not tail-recursive - acknowledged as simple implementation tradeoff
common_patterns.dense_accumulators: Sparse matrix operations using dense accumulators is a critical architectural flaw

immediate_fixes: Fix sparse matrix O(N^2) memory issue (sparse-coo-add-impl, sparse-csr-mul)
Add missing body field guard in query.ss (high crash risk)
Add path traversal protection to sanitize-tag-value
short_term: Fix matrix-from-lists crash on ragged input
Add empty input guards to convolution functions
tech_debt: Update file header paths from fabric/ to core/
Consider tail-recursive rewrites for data structure functions
Add caching to forum query functions
Standardize error handling (throw vs return error value)
